svg.title: A/B comparison ab.pivot v2: the result for each route
svg.desc: One cell per source and target set. The colour and the first line give the external reference; the cell gives the frames and the frames that B refuses. A dashed border marks a route through the viseme pose bridge.
svg.text: A/B comparison ab.pivot v2 (reproduce): every gate passes
B (the route through the canonical sets) runs on 37 routes and 117,816 frames, and gives the oracle's values on every frame.
A1: the retired direct map. A2: two retired direct maps in turn. A3: the expression library's FACS table. On each A1 route, B equals A1.
Most routes have no external reference: they are checked against the oracle only.
Dashed border: the route runs the viseme pose bridge.
"B refuses" counts frames on which at least one map refuses. Refusals are expected: the frames include planted faults (values out of range,
missing or invalid channels, non-finite edge values). On each A1 route, A1 refuses the same frames as B.
Source: ab/results/v2/ (scoreboard.md, b_equals_o.csv, refusals.csv, manifest.json) and the registration.
